intro: After a long day, Ebb greets you with ease. A touch of the remote lets you sink into quiet comfort, its high back and soft foam wrapping you fully so every pause feels like a personal retreat.

features.title: Recline at the touch of a button
features.text: Power-operated touch mechanism moves backrest and footrest together, letting you find your perfect angle without effort or noise.

features.title: Lift-up support for elderly comfort
features.text: The lift-up function helps elderly family members stand with ease, making it more than a chair, it’s a companion in everyday living.

features.title: High backrest that cocoons you
features.text: A tall, cushioned backrest supports your head, neck, and spine, letting you truly unwind whether you’re napping, streaming, or simply breathing out.

features.title: Soft foam for a floating feel
features.text: Seat, back, and armrests use slab stock foam for a balance of softness and support, creating a sinking yet buoyant comfort you can lose yourself in.

features.title: Durable frame for lasting strength
features.text: A combination of plywood and pinewood with moisture resistance and termite protection ensures structural strength for years.

features.title: Pocket that keep essentials close
features.text: Side pocket include a shallow slot for remotes and glasses, and easy access for tablets or magazines, keeping your space clutter-free.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Ebb Motorised 1-Seater Fabric Lift Up Recliner
